$comment: Intentional differences from the Claude Design canvas, at property level, each with a reason.
make parity accepts exactly these and fails on anything else. Keys are data-spec values, 'Component/*', or '<spec>@<Sheet>' for one occurrence of a name the canvas reuses on several sheets.

Each entry: {"path": "root" | "text \"…\"" | "mark[i]" (globs allowed), "prop": "<css property>" | "box.w" | … (globs allowed), "status": "approved" | "pending", "reason": "…", "source": "handoff §… | approved YYYY-MM-DD" (approved only)}.
pending entries are reported as ⚠ (not a pass) until a design decision approves or removes them.
